candidates.explanation: For FileDriver.LOCAL the transform prepends appConfig().frontendDomain to the stored relative path. Files are served by the backend, so it should use backendDomain. This puts the frontend host in avatar URLs, so they don't load.

fix.description: Use backendDomain instead of frontendDomain for the local driver.
